Destination Overview

Kollam, a beautiful coastal town in Kerala, is known for its stunning beaches, backwaters, and scenic beauty. This 3-day itinerary is designed to provide you with an exciting and adventurous experience in Kollam.

Day 1: Arrival and Beach Relaxation

  • Arrival in Kollam and check-in at a budget-friendly hotel
  • Visit the Thangasseri Lighthouse and enjoy the stunning views of the Arabian Sea
  • Relax on the beautiful beaches of Kollam, such as Mahatma Gandhi Beach or Thangasseri Beach
  • Dinner at a local seafood restaurant

Day 2: Backwater Cruises and Water Sports

  • Take a morning backwater cruise to explore the serene and tranquil beauty of the Ashtamudi Lake
  • Engage in water sports such as kayaking, paddleboarding, or swimming at the nearby beaches
  • Lunch at a local eatery near the lake
  • Visit the Kadapa Kumbalam Beach and enjoy the sunset

Day 3: Temple Visit and Departure

  • Visit the famous Sasthamkotta Lake and enjoy a peaceful boat ride
  • Explore the Sasthamkotta Sree Nagaraja Temple and learn about its rich history and cultural significance
  • Check-out from the hotel and depart from Kollam
